optional_measurements: Body response manifests record the original and narrowed light rigs. capture_body_reflections.py measures the four reflectors; normalize_confined_reflectors.py fits the intended socket/base glint regions. Use the recorded final light configs to rebuild without refitting.
rejected_continuity_sequence: bake_visibility.py with facing-start 0.1 and facing-full 0.55, then harmonic_hidden_pigment.py with protection-threshold 0.5 and feather 48. Exact inputs and parameters are in rejected-grazing-extension.json. This is not part of the accepted build.
validation_after_build: Copy the chosen saved model/render to the isolated models/bishop and assets/bishop.
Run validate_checkpoint.py in Blender, then render_diagnostics.py and render_clay.py from that saved model.
For Blender scripts with arguments, put -- between the script filename and its arguments.
Run mission_compare.py, material_statistics.py and compare.py; inspect full, head, base, clay and side/rear images.
Run refresh_review.py and both bishop interaction checks. Save the viewer JSON stdout as assets/bishop/viewer-validation.json.
Collect evidence, synchronize canonical and preview files, run affected site checks, then commit only bishop changes.
note: Baking writes assets/bishop/bishop-boxwood-albedo.png. It must check input-image preservation and reopened packed pixels. Sampling/Blender serialization may change regenerated file bytes; verify declared scene state and rendered fidelity. Do not promote rejected extensions or diagnostic emission renders.
